claims: The 2026 NHL Playoffs begin on April 18, 2026.
The 2026 NHL regular season concludes on April 16, 2026.
The first round of the 2026 NHL Playoffs runs from April 18 to May 3.
The second round of the 2026 NHL Playoffs starts on May 6.
The Conference Finals of the 2026 NHL Playoffs are on May 22.
The Stanley Cup Final of the 2026 NHL Playoffs is scheduled for June 3–21.
Carolina Hurricanes (1M) vs. Ottawa Senators (WC2) is a confirmed first round matchup in the Eastern Conference for the 2026 NHL Playoffs.
Buffalo Sabres (D2) vs. Boston Bruins (WC1) is a confirmed first round matchup in the Eastern Conference for the 2026 NHL Playoffs.
Tampa Bay Lightning (D2) vs. Montreal Canadiens (D3) is a confirmed first round matchup in the Eastern Conference for the 2026 NHL Playoffs.
Pittsburgh Penguins (D2) vs. Philadelphia Flyers (D3) is a confirmed first round matchup in the Eastern Conference for the 2026 NHL Playoffs.
Vegas Golden Knights (P1) vs. Utah Mammoth (WC1) is an initial first round matchup in the Western Conference for the 2026 NHL Playoffs.
Other first round matchups involving EDM, ANA, LAK, COL, DAL, MIN in the 2026 NHL Playoffs are to be finalized after the final regular-season games.
2026 NHL Playoff series use a best-of-seven, 2–2–1–1–1 format.
Home ice in the 2026 NHL Playoffs is awarded to the team with the better seed or regular-season record.
2026 NHL Playoff games are available on TNT.
2026 NHL Playoff games are available on ESPN.
2026 NHL Playoff games are available for streaming on ESPN+.
